pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.4: kiṃ nu 'mā 'va samaṇiyo yā samaṇiyo Sakyadhītaro. sant' aññāpi samaṇiyo lajjiniyo kukkuccikā sikkhākāmā, tās' āhaṃ santike brahmacariyaṃ carissāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.14: hi nāma bhikkhave Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.19.1: yā pana bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.20: buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi --pa-- sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmi; kiṃ nu 'mā 'va samaṇiyo yā samaṇiyo Sakyadhītaro; sant' aññāpi samaṇiyo lajjiniyo kukkuccikā sikkhākāmā, tās' āhaṃ santike brahmacariyaṃ carissāmīti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.21: sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.22: māyye kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca: buddhaṃ . . . carissāmīti. abhiram' ayye, svākkhāto dhammo, cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.23: evañ ca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.24: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.25: no ce paṭinissajjeyya, ayam pi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.12: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.24: sā bhikkhunī saṃghamajjham pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.26: buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi dhammaṃ paccācikkhāmi saṃghaṃ paccācikkhāmi sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmi . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.39: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.44: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.52: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.53: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya sā tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.57: samanubhaṭṭhā saṃghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.62: saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantiyā ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.66: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya āpajjati na saha vatthujjhācārā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññā na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññā na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
